meaning:
αἰτίωμα (Rec. αἰτίαμα, the usual form; see MM, VGT, see word), -τος, τό
(αἰτιάομαι, αἰτία),
a charge, accusation: Act.25:7.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,
